output_list.reason: The 'Typo Constructor' vulnerability is introduced due to a misspelled function name 'minToken' in the 'mintToken' function. An attacker can exploit this typo in the 'mintedAmount' parameter, allowing them to gain unexpected additional funds.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When balances[_from] is less than _value, it will overflow and set balances[_from] to zero, allowing attackers to steal tokens from any user.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When allowance[_from][msg.sender] is less than _value, it will overflow and set allowance[_from][msg.sender] to zero, allowing attackers to steal allowances from token owners.

The 'approve' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When balances[msg.sender] is less than _value, it will overflow and set balances[msg.sender] to zero, allowing attackers to steal tokens from the user.

The 'burn' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When balances[msg.sender] is less than _value, it will overflow and set balances[msg.sender] to zero, allowing attackers to steal tokens from the user.
